name: Clockmon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add up to 2 Digimon cards with different colors and ＜Save＞ in their texts among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has ＜Save＞ in its text, it gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.).
